title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Payton Page signs with Jets
items.desc: The Jets signed Payton Page to their practice squad.
items.impact: Page returns to the Jets after being waived by them and clearing waivers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DeVonta Smith explodes in Week 12 win over Cowboys
items.desc: DeVonta Smith hauled in 11 of his team-leading 14 targets for 200 yards and two touchdowns in the Eagles' 39-38 Week 12 win over the cowboys.
items.impact: Smith has been dynamic in the Philadelphia offense while battling injuries to this point, recording at least 75 receiving yards and one touchdown in three of his last five games. The wideout offers head coach Nick Sirianni an explosive pass-catching option as part of an inconsistent Philadelphia offense to this point, with a Week 13 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs explodes out of backfield in Week 12 loss to Bears
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns while also hauling in each of his five targets for 47 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Gibbs continues an explosive stretch out of the Detroit backfield, recording over 115 offensive yards and two or more touchdowns in each of his last three games. The running back remains an elite RB1 option in all formats entering a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jared Goff surpasses 300 yards in Week 12 loss to Bears
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 25-of-36 pass attempts for 313 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while also rushing three times for 10 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Goff fell slightly back to earth Thursday, tossing less than two touchdowns for the first time in his last three contests. The signal-caller remains one of the more stable quarterback options while guiding a high-octane Detroit offense for fantasy managers, with a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown leads pass-catches in Week 12 loss to Bears
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in seven of his team-leading 10 targets for 146 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: St. Brown continues an impactful stretch of late, recording five or more receptions in seven of his last eight games. The wideout remains a reliable WR1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jameson Williams hauls in six passes in Week 12 loss to Bears
items.desc: Jameson Williams hauled in six of nine targets for 68 yards while also rushing once for 12 yards in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Williams has been impactful in the Detroit passing attack of late, recording 50 or more receiving yards in six of his last eight games. The wideout continues to flash explosive potential as one of the more dynamic pass-catching options for head coach Dan Campbell ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sam LaPorta finds end zone in Week 12 loss to Bears
items.desc: Sam LaPorta hauled in four of his five targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 39-35 Week 12 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: LaPorta has offered modest results in the Detroit offense of late, recording over 40 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The tight end has frustrated fantasy managers to this point as a risky TE1 option, with a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sione Vaki sees eight touches in Week 12
items.desc: Sione Vaki rushed six times for 19 yards while also catching two of his three targets for a loss of four yards in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
items.impact: Vaki has made minimal impact out of the backfield of late, finishing with under 50 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back's value remains tied to the health of explosive RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs entering a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa sees one target in Week 12
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch his lone target in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
items.impact: TeSlaa has struggled to make an impact in the Detroit offense of late, registering less than 20 receiving yards in each of his last seven contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brock Wright sees one target in Week 12
items.desc: Brock Wright failed to catch his only target in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
items.impact: Wright has struggled to make an impact in the Detroit offense to this point, finishing with less than 15 receiving yards in 10 of 11 contests. The tight end can be left off rosters in all formats entering a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Conklin catches lone target in Week 12
items.desc: Tyler Conklin caught his lone target for nine yards in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
items.impact: Conklin remains minimally involved in the Detroit offense, recording one target or less in each of his nine contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Lions D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 12
items.desc: The Lions D/ST picked up four sacks while also forcing one turnover (one fumble recovery) in a 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
items.impact: The defense could not make stops when needed late Thursday, culminating in a game-sealing touchdown pass allowed with 0:03 remaining. The unit will look for a more impactful outing against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 13.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Bates misses extra point in Week 12
items.desc: Jake Bates converted both of his field goal attempts as well as three of his four extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Lions' 39-35 loss to the Bears in Week 12.
items.impact: Bates has been dynamic behind a high-powered offense to this point, recording seven or more points in 10 of 11 contests. The kicker will look to offer another prolific performance in a favorable Week 13 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Caleb Williams comes up clutch in Week 12 win over Lions
items.desc: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-44 pass attempts for 345 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing three times for 15 yards in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.impact: Williams has been impactful behind center of late, passing for two touchdowns in four of his last five games. The quarterback offers fantasy managers a dynamic QB1 option ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: D'Andre Swift dynamic in Week 12 win over Lions
items.desc: D'Andre Swift carried the ball nine times for 65 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in seven of his eight targets for a team-high 97 yards in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.impact: Swift continues an impactful stretch out of the backfield, recording one or more touchdowns in six of his last seven games. The running back remains an impactful RB1 option for head coach Ben Johnson ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Luther Burden III sees four touches in Week 12 win
items.desc: Luther Burden III hauled in three of his seven targets for 44 yards while also rushing once for one yard in the Bears' 39-35 win over the Lions in Week 12.
items.impact: Burden III has offered mixed results in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 90 receiving yards in three of his last six contests. The wideout continues to flash explosive potential in the Chicago offense ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rome Odunze hauls in two touchdowns in Week 12 win over Lions
items.desc: Rome Odunze hauled in six of his team-leading nine targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over Lions.
items.impact: Odunze has been impactful in the Chicago passing attack of late, registering 60 or more receiving yards in four of his last five games. The wideout remains one of the more reliable pass-catching options for head coach Ben Johnson entering a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
